messages.充電を貯めて充電力場を自分と味方に配る、守りのサポーター。: A defensive support that builds Charge and provides Charge Barrier to himself and allies.
messages.充電の獲得: S1「エネルギー循環」・S2「整理支援」の使用時と的中時に充電回数: **Gaining Charge**: Charge Count increases on use and on hit of S1 Energy Cycle and S2 Cleanup Support.
messages.充電力場: S2のⅡコインは充電回数に応じて次のターンに充電力場を得る。S3「充: **Charge Barrier**: Coin Ⅱ of S2 grants Charge Barrier next turn based on Charge Count. S3 Deploy Charge Barrier spends all Charge Count if it is 10 or more and gives (amount spent ÷ 2) Charge Barrier to the 2 allies with the lowest HP ratio, including himself. His Defense skill also grants Charge Barrier.
messages.S2: 自分にバリアがあるときマッチ威力が上がる。: **S2**: Clash Power rises while he has Shield.
messages.バトルパッシブ「慣れた整理業務」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘開始時: **Combat passive — Cleanup Mastery (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: At Combat Start, grants 2 Haste next turn if he has at least 5 Charge Count, and 1 more at 10 or more.
messages.S1・S2で充電回数を10以上貯め、S3で体力の低い味方に充電力場を配る。充電回: Build 10 or more Charge Count with S1 and S2, then hand out Charge Barrier to low-HP allies with S3. Keeping Charge Count up also raises his Speed through the passive, but spending all Charge Count with S3 makes the passive's Haste unlikely on the next turn.
